format: OSwind bounded live audio ingress observations v1
scope: Generated PCM/CoreMedia buffers, device-free AVAudioConverter, synthetic controller/ASR/context factories, owned encrypted volumes and local models, signed import/CLI/HTTP/MCP/portability processes. No real capture, capture latency, power or competitor performance acceptance.

newCoverage.stalledActor: Thirty complete segments supplied without actor delivery: exactly three waiting, one scheduled delivery, twenty-seven dropped segments counted
newCoverage.concurrentWriters: One thousand concurrent callbacks admit exactly one million samples into two complete and one partial segment before synchronous finish
newCoverage.realCoreMedia: Generated valid buffer reaches only its owned sink; wrong sample rate and oversized frame count stop before admission
newCoverage.microphoneConverter: Actual AVAudioConverter with generated 44.1/48 kHz stereo input resamples/downmixes to 16 kHz mono; changed format and oversized normalized capacity refuse
newCoverage.controller: Failure stops source; old sink cannot stop restart; explicit finish transfers actual pending/partial ingress; ninety dropped seconds reported and reset on next run

signedPackage.scope: Separately staged schema20 bounded PCM ingress and stream-owned adapters; no installation or native capture/input acceptance

retainedQualificationFailure.explanation: Transient attachment inventory while detach settles is consistent with these observations but was not captured at the failing instant; no driver change or identity relaxation was made
